text_block_list.text:
One day, with the Japanese Derby 
imminently approaching—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"—Now then, we've looked back over the 
Classic GⅠ races so far, but heading into 
the approaching showdown, the top favorite 
for the Derby has got to be her!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Showing off tremendous runs in both the 
Satsuki Sho and the NHK Mile Cup, the 'God 
of Destruction' of common sense! Tanino 
Gimlet!!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Combined with her unique personality, 
she's captured the hearts of many—she's an 
Umamusume everyone is watching right now!"

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
“—Even so, I can hardly believe it...! 
Running the NHK Mile Cup right after the 
Satsuki Sho, and then heading straight for 
the Derby too.”

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Would you say Tanino Gimlet's race 
rotation is quite unique after all?"

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"‘Going from the Satsuki Sho to the Derby 
is the orthodox route, but going from the 
NHK Mile Cup to the Derby is a whole 
different story.’"

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"After all, it's 1600m and 2400m. That's 
an 800m difference, you know? They're 
practically completely different races, 
and normally no one would even think about 
running them back-to-back."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
" 'In short, a 1,600m race where speed 
reigns supreme demands something 
completely different from a 2,400m race 
where stamina and overall versatility 
matter—' "

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"—If Gimlet wins the Derby, it suggests 
the potential to combine a miler's speed 
with total dominance at medium distances."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Man, if that really happens, it'll be 
incredible... Personally, I'd love to see 
it."

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Hearing that, it makes us want to root 
for her all the more—"

...In the media, Tanino Gimlet was heavily 
featured as the leading contender for the 
Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—That would be a fair evaluation, I 
suppose.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...Previously. It is just as—the Trainer 
analyzed."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Gimlet is— proving—her own strength.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: And next—she will appear before us.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Are you scared?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...My battle—with Gimlet.

...If I were to say I had no anxieties 
whatsoever, it would surely be a lie.

Terrifyingly, the depths of Tanino 
Gimlet's 'potential' have yet to be fully 
revealed.

There's even a chance her running will 
awaken further at the Japan Derby—

And yet. Even if there is an lingering 
anxiety that cannot be erased—
choice_data_list:
—It's all right. There's nothing to be 
afraid of.

—It's all right. There's nothing to be 
afraid of.

text_block_list.text:
As Symboli Kris S's trainer, I resolved to 
stand beside her, see things from her 
perspective, match her pace, and walk 
together to fulfill our mission.

"So, anxiety like this... I should easily 
be able to handle it, no matter what—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――It's time. ――Let us carry out our final 
adjustments.

"The moment to decide the pinnacle of the 
generation—the number one in Japan— was 
drawing ever closer—"
